messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — ran the weekly linkscan (link-checker) and it flagged ~120 broken links across /guides and /runtime. Rough breakdown: ~60 image 403s (CDN token issue?), ~40 404s to removed shortlinks, ~20 anchor/orphan anchors. Sample from the scan output below. Can someone on guides/references triage? I can prep a PR with redirects for high-traffic pages.

docs-bot: link-checker report (run by morgan) attached. Top domains: images.redwoodcdn.net (403), short.redwood.ai (404). Scan ID: lc-20260316-42.

tara: ugh, thanks for the flag. @alex_r are you able to look at the /guides hits? if it's CDN token expiry we might need a re-ingest.

alex_r: I'll take a look in the morning. Quick question — are the 403s clustered to a single prefix or scattered? if it's a single prefix we can re-upload and bump hashes.

morgan: Most 403s are under /assets/guides/images/2024-*/. A few are under /tutorials/embedded/examples/. Grep snippet I used: 

```
cat link-scan-lc-20260316.json | jq -r '.results[] | select(.status!=200) | "\(.url) \(.status)"' | head -n 20
# example lines:
# https://images.redwoodcdn.net/assets/guides/images/2024-09/diagram1.png 403
# https://short.redwood.ai/r/old-rl-setup 404
```

morgan: I also manually checked traffic and these broken-image pages are in the top 200 docs by monthly views — so worth prioritizing.

sre-bot: Alert: CDN token rotation completed 2026-03-10 04:12 UTC. Some objects still served from old origin for up to 72h by edge caches. If objects were re-uploaded before rotation, they may require cache invalidation.

tara: ok that points at a CDN/invalidation gap. @janet can you coordinate with infra SRE to invalidate the affected prefixes? Janet — I'll add the list to the ticket.

janet: on it. please paste the top prefixes you want invalidated and I'll open a maintenance ticket with infra-sre. we should also track the shortlink redirects separately.

morgan: here's a quick prioritized list (top 8):
- /assets/guides/images/2024-09/
- /assets/guides/images/2024-10/
- /tutorials/embedded/examples/
- /assets/runtime/diagrams/
- /assets/release/notices/
- /images/reference-samples/
- /legacy/shortlinks/redirects/
- /assets/guides/screenshots/old-ui/

morgan: I can open a PR with two parts: 1) add redirect rules for the most common removed shortlinks, 2) quick README note for doc owners about re-uploading images if invalidation doesn't fix it. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 (WIP).

alex_r: thanks — I'll review the PR today. For the 404 shortlinks we removed intentionally, can we map them to new canonical pages? for any ambiguous ones we should insert a human-friendly note rather than redirect to home.

tara: agreed. quick checklist: 
1) infra invalidates prefixes (janet)
2) morgan opens PR for redirects + README (morgan)
3) guides owners review mappings and approve (alex_r + others)
4) monitor linkscan next run and confirm < 10 failures (docs-bot)

janet: ticket opened INFRA-2289 — awaiting infra-sre ack. will post ETA here when they respond.

morgan: thanks all. I'll tidy the PR and add a sample mapping table in the PR description. If anyone wants to own mapping review for specific sections ping me and I'll assign. :thumbsup:

alex_r: I can take /guides and /tutorials mappings. ping me directly if you need help writing the redirect rules.

tara: great, closing the loop — will follow up after infra ack. :white_check_mark:
